scope: ControlDecoder strictly parses unverified proof transport and raw args JSON structure; ActionSchemas/authority/challenge/admission remain separate
wire: <=65536 original strict UTF8 bytes, single JSON object; exactly protocol/frameB64/signatureB64, optional delegationB64; unknown/duplicate decoded keys and all non-string wire values rejected
frame: ControlEnvelope validates <=35000B exact binary bytes. Outer protocol must equal fixed frame protocol. No fields duplicated outside signed frame.
signature: canonical Base64url <=72B, strict P256 DER syntax via CryptoEncoding; NOT key lookup or ECDSA verification
delegation: absent iff all-zero signed digest; if present nonempty<=8192B canonical Base64url with exact signed SHA256 digest; certificate validity/issuer/ceiling still unverified
args: parse frame's ORIGINAL <=32768 UTF8 bytes; require object, reject duplicate keys, invalid Unicode, trailing input, coercion/non-JSON numbers. Never reserialize for signature. Unknown action/args fields remain ActionSchemas responsibility.
numbers: retain immutable raw number token, never float conversion or string/boolean coercion. Per-action exact integer/range/default/null rules must subsequently be checked.
unicode: strict UTF8 decoder REPORT; no BOM; escaped UTF16 high surrogate must be immediately paired with escaped low surrogate; unescaped controls/lone surrogates rejected. No key normalization; escaped aliases of same decoded key count duplicates.
result: immutable UnverifiedProof with signed frame, defensive-copy signature/delegation, immutable typed JSON value tree. Name/type deliberately not ActorContext or authorized request.
error: generic private-value-free rejection; no partial request callbacks or side effects
notReadyIntegration: compiled principal/delegation validity and real ECDSA verify
withdrawWhen: A reviewed action genuinely needs larger structured JSON; adjust explicit budgets and stress tests rather than dropping bounds or adding coercion
historicalContractNote: R14 control-proof-format.json remains byte-pinned by historical cross-implementation evidence; its implementation-pending text is historical. Current source/status is this R20 contract and implementation-readiness.json, not an edit of old evidence.
